title: Sister
html:
• Saṁyutta Nikāya 15.17 Linked Discourses 15.17
  • 2. Dutiyavagga Chapter Two

Bhaginisutta Sister

Sāvatthiyaṁ viharati …pe… At Sāvatthī.

“na so, bhikkhave, satto sulabharūpo yo nabhaginibhūtapubbo …pe… “It’s not easy to find a sentient being who in all this long time has not previously been your sister. … alaṁ vimuccitun”ti. This is quite enough for you to become disillusioned, dispassionate, and freed regarding all conditions.”

Sattamaṁ.
